title: A New Media Giant: Paramount and Warner Bros. Join to Create Skydance
subtitle: The $111 billion merger creates a massive entertainment company, but raises questions about the future of news and competition.

summary.en: Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery have officially completed a $111 billion merger to form a new media company called Skydance. Led by David Ellison, the organization now controls major film studios, streaming services, and news outlets like CNN and CBS. While the company promises to create more content, the deal faced significant legal challenges from state officials concerned about market competition. Critics also worry about the influence of the new leadership on independent news reporting. A legal settlement requires the company to maintain specific production levels and editorial independence for its news divisions.
summary.zh: 派拉蒙與華納兄弟探索公司已正式完成價值一千一百一十億美元的合併案，成立了名為「天空之舞」的新媒體公司。該組織由大衛·艾利森領導，目前掌控了大型電影製片廠、串流服務，以及 CNN 與哥倫比亞廣播公司新聞網等新聞媒體。儘管公司承諾將創造更多內容，但這筆交易因市場競爭問題面臨州政府官員的重大法律挑戰。批評者也擔憂新領導層對獨立新聞報導的影響。法律和解協議要求該公司必須維持特定的產出水準，並確保其新聞部門的編輯獨立性。

paragraphs.en: A major change has arrived in the world of entertainment. On Tuesday, Paramount completed its $111 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. This deal creates a new, massive media company named Skydance. The merger brings together some of the most famous names in film and television, including Paramount Pictures, Warner Bros. Pictures, HBO Max, and various cable networks like MTV and the Food Network. With this move, the industry sees two of the last five traditional Hollywood studios combine into one giant organization.
paragraphs.zh: 娛樂界迎來了一項重大變革。週二，派拉蒙（Paramount）完成了對華納兄弟探索公司（Warner Bros. Discovery）價值一千一百一十億美元的收購案。這筆交易催生了一家名為「天空之舞」（Skydance）的全新大型媒體公司。此次合併匯集了影視界最負盛名的品牌，包括派拉蒙影業、華納兄弟影業、HBO Max，以及 MTV 和美食頻道（Food Network）等各類有線電視網。此舉象徵著好萊塢最後五大傳統片廠中的兩家正式合併為一個巨型組織。

paragraphs.en: David Ellison, the son of a billionaire technology mogul, will lead the new company as CEO. He will work alongside Ynon Kreiz, the former head of Mattel, who will serve as co-executive. According to The Guardian Business, Ellison described the merger as a historic moment for the industry. He stated that the goal of the deal is to create a stronger competitor with the resources to tell great stories on every platform for audiences around the world. Ellison noted that the company now owns a library of 15,000 films, featuring popular series like Harry Potter, Mission Impossible, and The Godfather.
paragraphs.zh: 科技業億萬富豪之子大衛·艾利森（David Ellison）將擔任這家新公司的執行長。他將與前美泰兒（Mattel）負責人伊農·克雷茲（Ynon Kreiz）共事，後者將擔任共同執行官。根據《衛報》商業版報導，艾利森形容此次合併是產業歷史性的一刻。他表示，這筆交易的目標是打造一個更強大的競爭者，擁有足夠的資源，能在全球各個平台上為觀眾講述精彩的故事。艾利森指出，該公司目前擁有包含一萬五千部電影的片庫，其中包括《哈利波特》、《不可能的任務》以及《教父》等熱門系列作品。

paragraphs.en: Despite the excitement from leadership, the path to this merger was difficult. The deal faced months of legal trouble and public protests. According to NPR Business, 12 state attorneys general and the Writers Guild of America tried to stop the merger in court. They argued that the deal would hurt competition and lead to fewer choices for movie fans. While the merger was approved in June, the legal battle continued until a settlement was reached last month. As part of this agreement, Skydance must release at least 30 films and 180 television shows every year. A trustee will watch the company to ensure it follows these rules, and California officials have stated they are ready to return to court if the company fails to comply.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管領導層對此感到振奮，但合併之路卻困難重重。這筆交易面臨了長達數月的法律糾紛與公眾抗議。根據美國國家公共廣播電台（NPR）商業版報導，十二位州檢察長與美國編劇工會曾試圖在法庭上阻止這項合併。他們主張這筆交易將損害市場競爭，並導致電影愛好者的選擇減少。雖然合併案於六月獲得批准，但法律攻防戰一直持續到上個月達成和解為止。作為協議的一部分，天空之舞每年必須發行至少三十部電影與一百八十部電視節目。一位受託人將監督該公司以確保其遵守規定，加州官員也已表示，若公司未能遵守，他們隨時準備重回法庭。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the business side, there is significant concern regarding the future of news. Skydance now controls two major news organizations: CBS News and CNN. Some observers worry about the political influence of David Ellison and his father, Larry Ellison, who is a known supporter of the Trump administration. Critics fear that the new leadership might try to change how these news outlets report on politics. Jessica Gonzalez, a leader at the nonprofit group Free Press, told NPR that many people are worried about the potential for the owners to use their power to influence or censor the news.
paragraphs.zh: 除了商業層面，新聞業的未來也引發了重大擔憂。天空之舞目前掌控了兩大新聞機構：哥倫比亞廣播公司新聞網（CBS News）與美國有線電視新聞網（CNN）。部分觀察家擔心大衛·艾利森及其父親賴瑞·艾利森（Larry Ellison）的政治影響力，後者是川普政府的知名支持者。批評者擔心新領導層可能會試圖改變這些新聞媒體報導政治的方式。非營利組織「自由新聞」（Free Press）的負責人潔西卡·岡薩雷斯（Jessica Gonzalez）向 NPR 表示，許多人擔心業主可能會利用其權力來影響或審查新聞。

paragraphs.en: These concerns are linked to earlier changes at CBS News. After David Ellison’s Skydance Corporation bought Paramount last year, he appointed Bari Weiss to lead CBS News. Weiss is a former writer for The New York Times who started her own media outlet. Since her appointment, some have accused the network of showing bias toward the Trump administration. In response to these worries, CNN’s CEO, Mark Thompson, announced he would stay in his role. He stated that he has spoken with Skydance leadership and feels confident that they will support the practice of independent news.
paragraphs.zh: 這些擔憂與哥倫比亞廣播公司新聞網先前的人事變動有關。在大衛·艾利森的天空之舞公司去年收購派拉蒙後，他任命了巴里·魏斯（Bari Weiss）領導該新聞網。魏斯曾是《紐約時報》的撰稿人，後來創辦了自己的媒體平台。自她上任以來，有人指控該新聞網對川普政府表現出偏頗。針對這些疑慮，CNN 執行長馬克·湯普森（Mark Thompson）宣布他將留任。他表示已與天空之舞的領導層溝通過，並對他們將支持獨立新聞實踐感到有信心。

paragraphs.en: As the company begins this new chapter, the industry is watching closely. The merger represents a shift in how media is produced and distributed. While Ellison claims the deal is good for the creative economy and will provide more content for viewers, the skepticism from regulators and media advocates remains strong. The future of Skydance will depend on whether it can balance its massive business goals with the need to maintain independent, trusted news and fair competition in the entertainment market. For now, the company is moving forward, promising that its work is only just beginning.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著公司邁入新篇章，業界正密切關注。此次合併代表了媒體製作與發行方式的轉變。儘管艾利森聲稱這筆交易對創意經濟有利，並將為觀眾提供更多內容，但監管機構與媒體倡議者的質疑聲浪依然強烈。天空之舞的未來將取決於它能否在龐大的商業目標與維持獨立、可信的新聞報導以及娛樂市場公平競爭之間取得平衡。目前，該公司正持續向前邁進，並承諾這一切僅僅是開始。

quiz.question: What specific obligation must Skydance fulfill as part of the legal settlement reached last month?

options.A: They must sell off CBS News and CNN to avoid a monopoly.
options.B: They are required to produce a minimum number of films and TV shows annually.
options.C: They must appoint a government official to the board of directors.
options.D: They must donate a portion of their profits to the Writers Guild of America.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，為了達成和解，Skydance 必須每年發行至少 30 部電影和 180 部電視節目。選項 A 錯誤，文章提到他們控制了這些新聞機構，但未說要出售；選項 C 錯誤，文章提到的是由一名「受託人 (trustee)」監督公司是否遵守規定，而非指派政府官員進入董事會；選項 D 錯誤，文中並未提及捐款給編劇協會的規定。

quiz.question: Why are some observers concerned about the future of news reporting under the new company?

options.A: Because David Ellison has announced plans to shut down CNN and CBS News.
options.B: Because the company is struggling financially and may cut news budgets.
options.C: Because the new owners have political ties that might lead to biased news coverage.
options.D: Because the Writers Guild of America has banned the company from producing news.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第四段與第五段提到，David Ellison 及其父親 Larry Ellison 與川普政府關係密切，且自從 Bari Weiss 被任命領導 CBS News 後，已有關於新聞偏頗的指控。這顯示外界擔憂的是政治立場影響新聞獨立性。選項 A 錯誤，文中並未提到要關閉新聞台；選項 B 錯誤，文章並未討論財務縮減問題；選項 D 錯誤，編劇協會反對的是合併案本身，而非禁止公司製作新聞。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'skepticism' mean as used in the text?

options.A: A feeling of doubt or lack of belief.
options.B: An enthusiastic support for a new idea.
options.C: A legal process used to stop a business deal.
options.D: A formal agreement between two competing companies.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在文末提到，儘管 Ellison 宣稱合併對創意經濟有益，但監管機構和媒體倡議者仍抱持「skepticism」。根據上下文，這指的是人們對其說法持懷疑態度，並不完全相信。選項 B 與文意相反；選項 C 雖然文章前面提過法律訴訟，但該字詞本身是指一種心態而非法律程序；選項 D 則是指 merger（合併），與 skepticism 的定義無關。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of this article?

options.A: To provide a biography of David Ellison and his career in technology.
options.B: To explain the history of Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery.
options.C: To describe the technical process of how a media merger is completed.
options.D: To discuss the formation of Skydance, its goals, and the associated controversies.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。本文全面涵蓋了 Paramount 與 Warner Bros. Discovery 合併成立 Skydance 的事件，並探討了該公司的目標（如增加內容產出）、面臨的法律挑戰以及對新聞獨立性的擔憂。選項 A 過於狹隘，僅聚焦於個人；選項 B 僅提及歷史背景，非全文重點；選項 C 錯誤，文章並未解釋合併的技術細節，而是關注商業與社會影響。
